references.text: This verse gives the original instructions for the north side of the courtyard, with the same measurements: one hundred cubits long, twenty pillars and twenty bases of bronze, with hooks and rods of silver.
Describes the south side of the courtyard with identical measurements and materials, showing the symmetry in the tabernacle's construction.
The entire passage giving God's instructions for the construction of the courtyard, of which this verse is the fulfillment.
Provides further details about the pillars' bronze bases and the silver hooks and rods mentioned in this verse.
Describes similar construction elements with pillars, gold hooks, and bronze bases for the entrance to the tabernacle.
This is the underlying instruction for the north side's pillars confirming that the number and materials were set before the execution in chapter 38.
The general instruction defining the material requirement (silver/bronze) for the entire courtyard, thus providing context for the specific execution on the north side.
Emphasizes the hierarchy in the sanctuary by showing that the pillars at the entrance to the holy place itself were overlaid with gold, unlike the bronze/silver combination on the north side.
